title: Help and about
summary: The Ajuda e sobre group: support, help pages, terms, privacy, report a problem, open source licences, and a footer with the steward line, the app version and the device ID.

version.description: versionName and build number from product/version.json as the build carries them, for example 26.10.2 (12).

deviceId.description: Client.deviceId. Shown small; a long press copies it.

of.description: One dependency with its licence text.

licences.description: The open source licences screen: every dependency of the build (matrix-rust-sdk Apache-2.0, Phosphor MIT and others) with its licence, and Bipe's own AGPL-3.0 with the app store permission (ADR 0144).

key.description: docs, terms or privacy: an entry of registries/settings.json urls.

openUrl.effect: Opens the pt or en URL in the system browser.

copyDeviceId.effect: Copies deviceId, shows bipe_help_device_id_copied, tap haptic.

notes: Help links go to bipe.chat, never to element.io (parity help-links).
bipe_help_version takes the version string; bipe_app_sdk_version shows the matrix-rust-sdk version under it.
The licence list is generated at build time from the dependency manifests; the licence check of the bipe-app CI keeps it honest (plan section 2).
